'''A Stormy Time in the Battle Subway''' (Japanese: '''VS トルネロス・ボルトロス''' ''VS Tornadus & Thundurus''), titled '''VS Tornadus / Thundurus''' in the [[Shogakukan Asia]] translation, is the 490th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 30th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Black & White}}.

It is subtitled '''Tornadus/Thundurus''' (Japanese: '''風雷''' ''Wind and Thunder'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''A Stormy Time in the Battle Subway''' in the Shogakukan Asia translation.

==Plot==
{{Incomplete plot}}

==Major events==
* {{adv|White}} continues her travel on the [[Battle Subway]].
* White meets [[Shauntal]], one of the [[Elite Four]].
* {{DL|Forces of nature (Adventures)|Tornadus}} and {{DL|Forces of nature (Adventures)|Thundurus}} battle each other, causing havoc on the train.
* {{DL|Forces of nature (Adventures)|Landorus}} arrives to stop Tornadus and Thundurus from fighting.
* [[Giallo]] captures the [[forces of nature]].
* The Battle Subway heads to [[Anville Town]].

{{Adventuresevents}}
{{endspoilers}}
